rebuttal_or_critique: I remain steadfast in my position. The argument that food inflation is purely a supply-side phenomenon ignores the risk of spillovers into broader inflation expectations. With headline CPI at 5.10% and a positive output gap of 0.50%, the economy is operating at a level that does not permit a premature shift to a neutral stance. We must ensure that the disinflationary process is durable and not merely a reflection of core moderation. Any signal of easing, such as a shift to neutral, would be counterproductive to our mandate of price stability.
